�️ 2 habitaciones, actualmente equipadas con literas para aprovechar al máximo el espacio.

❄️ Aire acondicionado, situado en la zona de acceso a las habitaciones.

inv.desc_en:
TURIA HOMES presents:
UNIQUE OPPORTUNITY · RENOVATED LOFT-STYLE GROUND FLOOR IN NOU MOLES
✨ Completely renovated in 2026 · Move-in ready · Street level access
LICENSED AS COMMERCIAL PREMISES
Discover this cozy loft-style property, completely renovated in 2026, located in Nou Moles, Valencia, in a well-established area surrounded by all services and just a few minutes from the Turia Gardens.
A property with personality, practical and very versatile, perfect both for those looking for a move-in ready home and for those seeking an interesting investment opportunity.
✨ TWO-STORY LAYOUT
The property features a functional and well-utilized layout:
Ground floor
Upon entering directly from the street, we find an open-plan, cozy, and bright space, consisting of:
️ Spacious living-dining room? Equipped American-style kitchen, integrated into the space? Full bathroom with shower tray and screen? Independent street-level entrance, providing comfort and privacy
Warm tones, exposed wood walls, and a combination of stoneware and laminate flooring create an especially pleasant and welcoming atmosphere.
First floor
On the upper floor, there are:
️ 2 bedrooms, currently equipped with bunk beds to maximize space.? Auxiliary toilet
❄️ Air conditioning, located in the access area to the bedrooms.
The bedrooms have small-format windows.
✨ QUALITIES AND FEATURES
Comprehensive renovation completed in 2026
Building constructed in 2005
Independent entrance from the street
Loft-style layout
Living-dining room with American-style kitchen
Equipped kitchen
2 bedrooms
1 full bathroom + 1 toilet
Exposed wood walls
Warm tones and cozy atmosphere
Stoneware and laminate flooring
High-security reinforced exterior door
Air conditioning
✨ NOU MOLES · VALENCIA
Located in Nou Moles, a well-established area of Valencia with an excellent range of services and transport links.
The property is located near the Turia Gardens and with supermarkets, shops, public transport, and all kinds of services in the surrounding area.
An ideal location to enjoy the city with everything you need nearby.
✨ AN INVESTMENT WITH MANY POSSIBILITIES
Its independent street-level entrance, its two-story layout, and its recent renovation make this property an especially attractive option for different profiles.
No renovations needed: it is ready to move into and start enjoying from day one.
It can also be an interesting alternative for those looking for a property with profitability potential in Valencia, in a well-established and well-connected area.
⭐ A DIFFERENT PROPERTY
If you are looking for something more than a conventional apartment, this renovated loft in Nou Moles may be just what you are looking for.
Renovated in 2026 · Street level · 2 bedrooms · 2 bathrooms · Loft style · Near the Turia · All services
✨ Come see it
A property with character, completely renovated and ready to start a new chapter.
Do you want it to live in or as an investment? You decide the possibilities.
